result.title: Can LLM Agents Resolve Service Failures? Simulating Multi-Turn Complaint Handling under Information Asymmetry
result.summary: LLM agents are widely adopted in service chatbots for rule-guided support and information access, yet emotionally demanding complaint handling still relies heavily on human agents. We introduce ServiceBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark dedicated to complaint handling, with 2,500 scenarios spanning 184 complaint categories and five service industries. We propose Asymmetric Progressive Complaint Simulation (APCS) to simulate realistic complaint handling, together with a justice-based evaluation framework. Our experiments reveal that even capable LLM agents struggle to handle complaints effectively. They lack the ability to proactively gather information and strategically guide conversations toward resolution, often resorting to premature compensation. We further show that targeted post-training with SFT and DPO substantially improves these capabilities, enabling a smaller model to match or surpass much larger models on several outcomes.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ServiceBench，一个面向投诉处理的基准，含 2500 个场景、184 类投诉与五个服务行业，并用「非对称渐进投诉模拟」（APCS）与基于公正性的评价框架测试 LLM agent；实验显示 agent 难以主动索取信息、引导对话收敛，往往过早给出赔偿，而 SFT 与 DPO 后训练能明显改善。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「信息不对称下主动获取信息、避免过早行动」的设置，可能为 LVR/VLM 中是否先获取视觉证据再作答、以及停止与成本权衡的评价提供概念参照，但场景为纯文本服务对话，迁移性有待核查。
